description: Reads one Etsy listing from Etsy's API: title, the 13 tags, photo count and sizes, video, when it expires and whether it auto-renews, favorites, and whether the description mentions AI. Applies Etsy's published title/tag rules and returns the first thing to fix. Use for 'is my listing set up right?' and 'when does my listing expire?'.

url.description: Etsy listing link (etsy.com/listing/<number>) or the listing number

name: etsy_listing_check
title: Check an Etsy listing
